digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET backstop
propositions: Explicit review-plan on a bug with non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking DET rubric at both enforcement seams: precheck det_blocking and route_criteria tier selection, while preserving claim-time exemption and light tier for test-only or absent file_impact.

Gerrit DET criterion must block oversized bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) that lack a current-or-drifted plan-review attestation, using cross-host opcert verification against the project trust root rather than own-env reads.

Plan-review attestation verification must read CROSS-HOST via opcert_from_record decoded to trusted_env_keyring of the record principal, then verify_opcert and compute_validity with plan-review kind and DEFAULT profile, accepting only certified/stale-code/stale-head and flagging all other plan-reachable and op-cert-failure verdicts.

Non-test line classification rule (tests/** and conftest.py excluded) and the 150-line threshold must be stated and tested as a single named constant shared by the Gerrit criterion and backtest script.
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must achieve exact set equality: flagged commits == the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive fixes and zero mechanical false positives.
Debug-skill Phase-1-exit hook must invoke review-plan for non-trivial fixes, coordinating with ticket 78f1's writeback anchor integration.
